Open Kentucky on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 5, 2026. Online and in-person registration closes at 4:00 p.m. local time. Mailed applications must be postmarked by October 5.
  • Last day to request a mail-in absentee ballot: October 20, 2026. Requests close at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time. A mail-in ballot requires an excuse. The county clerk must receive your ballot by 6:00 p.m. local time on Election Day.
  • Excused in-person early voting: October 21, 2026 to October 28, 2026. Only for voters with a qualifying excuse. Open on weekdays: Oct 21–23 and Oct 26–28.
  • No-excuse in-person early voting: October 29, 2026 to October 31, 2026. Open to all voters Thursday through Saturday. Your county sets the hours and locations.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 6:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. local time (Eastern or Central). If you are in line at 6:00 p.m., you can still vote.

Official election information: Kentucky State Board of Elections

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.
